characters.summary: Reed Richards of Earth-838 is a brilliant scientist and leader of the Illuminati who utilizes advanced elastic physiology to stretch, reshape, and endure physical trauma. He relies on intellect and scientific insight as much as his superhuman physical flexibility.

mechanisms: Elastic body that absorbs blunt force trauma

weaknesses: Vulnerable to catastrophic kinetic destruction under extreme psychic or physical overload
limitations: Physical elasticity has structural limits when subjected to reality-warping or overwhelming magical attacks

sources.supports: Abilities, feats, and combat style of Mister Fantastic in the MCU

feats.claim: Stretched his limbs and body to engage in combat against Wanda Maximoff
feats.citation: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

notableResults.citation: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
notableResults.note: Killed when his body was systematically dismantled by reality-warping.

campaignTags.claim: World-renowned scientist and brilliant inventor of Earth-838
Utilizes advanced technology and scientific apparatus

unknowns: Full extent of his technological inventions and lab resources available in combat is not fully shown on screen.

characters.summary: Michelle Jones-Watson (MJ) is a resourceful, highly intelligent civilian ally who relies on quick thinking, improvisational weapons, and environmental awareness during high-stress conflicts rather than innate superpowers.

techniques: Improvised melee strikes with heavy objects

weaknesses: Standard human physical vulnerability with no superhuman durability
limitations: Lacks combat training or superhuman powers

sources.supports: Skills, tactical awareness, and background of MJ

feats.claim: Defended herself using a mace and various heavy objects against villains at the Statue of Liberty

notableResults.note: Evaded and fought defensively with assistance from Spider-Man.

unknowns: No formal combat training history documented.

characters.summary: Monica Rambeau absorbs and manipulates electromagnetic spectrum energy, granting her flight, energy projection, and intangible phasing capabilities after passing through Wanda Maximoff's Hex barrier.

mechanisms: Phase shifting to pass through solid objects or attacks

weaknesses: Vulnerable to unexpected physical impacts when tangible
limitations: New to her powers and still mastering full offensive scale

sources.supports: Superhuman powers, energy manipulation, and flight of Monica Rambeau

feats.claim: Absorbed bullet impacts and passed through energy barriers unharmed

notableResults.note: Attempted negotiation before being hurled through a barrier.

unknowns: Full capacity of her cosmic energy spectrum output in prolonged warfare.

characters.summary: Marc Spector is a mercenary empowered by the Egyptian moon god Khonshu, operating as Moon Knight with enhanced durability, regenerative healing, and a versatile arsenal of crescent darts and tactical gear.
weaknesses: Psychological vulnerability due to dissociative identity disorder
limitations: Behavior and effectiveness can be disrupted by switching alters (Steven Grant or Jake Lockley)

sources.supports: Abilities, equipment, and combat background of Moon Knight

feats.claim: Slaughtered multiple jackal creatures in close combat using his suit's durability

conditional.ability: Full mystical suit and divine healing

campaignTags.claim: Empowered by the Egyptian god Khonshu
Uses crescent darts and specialized tactical gear

unknowns: Exact limits of Khonshu's intervention when Moon Knight is incapacitated.

characters.summary: Jake Lockley is the third, ruthless alter of Marc Spector, characterized by cold efficiency, multilingualism, and a willingness to kill without hesitation while wearing the Moon Knight attire.
weaknesses: Hidden within a shared psyche, prone to surprise emergence
characters.formDifferences: Exhibits a far more ruthless and lethal fighting style compared to Marc Spector or Steven Grant, directly executing adversaries on Khonshu's behalf.

sources.supports: Jake Lockley identity, connection to Khonshu, and brutality

notableResults.note: Ambushed and subdued Harrow at Khonshu's behest.

unknowns: Full extent of his combat skills independent of the Moon Knight suit.

characters.summary: Mr. Knight represents Steven Grant's manifestation of the Moon Knight avatar, clad in a sharp white three-piece suit, utilizing baton combat and precise defensive maneuvers while retaining mystical armor properties.
weaknesses: Initially lacking in aggressive killer instinct compared to Marc
characters.formDifferences: Features a white three-piece suit aesthetic and relies more on evasive, acrobatic, and baton-based control rather than brutal melee slaughter.

sources.supports: Mr. Knight persona, appearance, and combat capabilities

notableResults.note: Fought alongside Marc to defeat monsters in London.

unknowns: Degree to which Steven's hesitation limits the persona's combat output.

weaknesses: Strict adherence to dogmatic laws leaves him inflexible against unconventional rule-breaking opponents
limitations: Relies heavily on hand gestures and focus to channel mystic artifacts and spells

notableResults.note: Participated in training spars and doctrinal disputes.

campaignTags.claim: Master of mystic arts and spells

unknowns: Exact whereabouts and magical upgrades acquired after breaking away from Kamar-Taj.

characters.summary: Kamala Khan harnesses hard-light constructs derived from her Noor-infused DNA and a mysterious bangle, allowing her to generate giant fists, stepping platforms, and glowing shields in combat.
weaknesses: Dependent on the bangle for optimal power channeling; inexperienced in lethal warfare
limitations: Constructs require mental concentration and can shatter under severe concentrated force

sources.supports: Hard-light powers, bangle origin, and abilities of Kamala Khan

feats.claim: Created giant glowing fists to subdue attackers and stepping platforms to cross gaps

notableResults.note: Evaded and incapacitated agents using hard-light traps.

campaignTags.claim: Channels dimensional Noor energy via an ancient bangle

characters.summary: Quentin Beck orchestrates elaborate illusions using swarms of tactical drones, holographic projectors, and psychological manipulation to deceive opponents into perceiving overwhelming, impossible threats.
weaknesses: Physically fragile without his tech and drones; highly dependent on computer network connectivity
limitations: Illusions fail or reveal themselves if the underlying drones are destroyed

notableResults.note: Defeated when Spider-Man used his spider-sense to bypass the illusions and destroy the drones.
